topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that reconstruct speech acoustics from intracranial recordings made during overt, mouthed, attempted or imagined speech (the published intracranial-synthesis population pattern), classified by the neural-to-acoustic regression model their full text names: linear or regularized linear regression, recurrent network (LSTM/GRU), transformer, 3D convolution, DenseNet, unit selection. Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text names, including related-work mentions, so counts are upper bounds; heard-speech reconstruction and text-only decoders read out by TTS are outside the topic; versions of one study count once.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes linear_regression, recurrent, transformer, conv_3d, densenet, unit_selection
topics.metric: spectrogram Pearson correlation (PCC) under per-participant evaluation

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: intracranial production-speech acoustic reconstruction, classified by how predicted acoustic features become a waveform (neural vocoder, Griffin-Lim, parametric vocoder, unit selection).
Reused published table: neural-to-acoustic speech reconstruction studies, classified by evaluation (correlation, identification among candidates, MCD, listener test, STOI).
Reused published table: intracranial speech decoding studies, classified by how test data are separated (random trial split, k-fold, held-out session, held-out subject).
